No GM word stands behind the enlarged bath: make canon finds none of Hajime, 'enlarged bath', 'sweaty'; the particular entered on 2026-07-12 as the session's reading of the OP traits (Permanent Wound, sweaty), and the notes' list of GM rulings names the karo, the massing, the shrine and the lineage, not the bath. The record's silence is on a bath's SIZE, a research question 0105's GUESS label already answers; the held question is which of two project choices wins (0105's 10 x 8 guess or the rolled particular), the kind of tradeoff the 2026-10-02 ruling leaves to the session. The question as framed also rests on an unmeasured premise - that keeping the particular is what takes Hayakawa's house past 49 tsubo. Measured today (make size-table on the sheet): the residence blocks 2,429 + 2,042 sq ft and the kitchen 1,332, about 5,800 sq ft (~163 tsubo) without the bath, against which the enlargement over 10 x 8 adds 136 sq ft (~3.8 tsubo); the house's size is the open E3 row Scale#residence wing length, not this one. The plan names which fix it takes: record the enlarged bath as a labeled GUESS particular (a knob-7 roll) on 0105's drawing page and claim the procedure's line - a page edit, through 328's FR-004 exception path to spec-fidelity, not to the GM - or draw it 10 x 8 like the others. The spec's Decisions row 'kept as its rolled particular' follows whichever is taken.
